title: Outis Local Pilot File and Folder Architecture

document_role.ratification_gate: The approved spec and implementation plan must bind every created, changed, generated, or removed path.

architecture_rules.primary_rule: Every production file has one semantic responsibility and one owning runtime or evidence surface.
architecture_rules.dependency_direction: macOS app -> generated FFI contract -> outis-ffi -> outis-runtime -> outis-core
rules: outis-core must not depend on Swift, macOS frameworks, a model runtime, a database engine, Keychain, or FFI.

outis-runtime owns approved local Rust side effects and concrete adapters; native Word/PDF/OCR remains in the macOS application target; no separate adapter crate is created without measured compile or isolation need.
outis-ffi owns only the language boundary and must not duplicate domain behavior.
The macOS application owns user interaction and platform access; it must not reimplement Rust transformation rules.
Synthetic fixtures, evaluation code, benchmarks, generated bindings, and model artifacts remain outside production source targets.
No file or directory is created as an empty placeholder.
No path for Finder, remote services, RAG, rendering, or post-quantum services is created in the first slice.

Rust runtime owns strict .txt and .md extraction; the single macOS application target owns small AppKit Word, PDFKit PDF, Core Graphics render, and Vision OCR adapters; no format-specific crate or extra Xcode target is created.

Every successfully processed source maps to exactly one .md target under a separate outis root; target paths preserve the source-relative structure and base names only after sensitive component tokenization.

naming_and_size_policy.swift_files: UpperCamelCase matching the primary type or screen
naming_and_size_policy.test_files: named for the behavior or contract under test
naming_and_size_policy.threshold_rule: Crossing a threshold requires responsibility review. Split only at a semantic boundary; do not fragment cohesive code to satisfy a number.
naming_and_size_policy.public_api_rule: Module roots export only spec-bound types and entrypoints. Everything else remains private.

required_s1_ratifications.decision: Ratify Rust strict UTF-8 extraction; AppKit Word import; PDFKit PDF text and access checks; Core Graphics 200-DPI rendering; Vision revision 3 accurate OCR with ordered Italian, German, and French languages, automatic language detection, language correction disabled, and sequential pages; mandatory embedded Quick Look binary review with exact hash-bound confirmation; normalized-document and provenance schemas; limits; failures; fixtures; and validation commands.
Ratify the R1.1 exact NER candidate and R1 address assembler for the synthetic demo; model legal redistribution and signed packaging remain implementation blockers.
Ratify rusqlite 0.40.2 with bundled SQLite 3.53.2, one connection, exact PRAGMAs, schema, migration, permissions, deletion, and synthetic-only plaintext-vault limitation.
Ratify that no Keychain item or vault secret exists in the synthetic funding demo; confidential-data use remains blocked pending encrypted-vault research.

Ratify Rust repr(C) as ABI source, cbindgen 0.29.4 for generated/ffi/outis.h, a reviewed source module map, staticlib linking, UTF-8 JSON wire schemas, polling, outis_job_submit_extraction with separate bounded plaintext text and provenance buffers, and release ownership.

Ratify the fixed export and staging names, first-publish rename, RENAME_SWAP-only replacement, sync, cancellation, cleanup, and last-valid-output behavior; failure injection remains required before readiness claims.

approval_effect: Approval accepts this as an R1 roadmap companion candidate. It does not create paths. S1 and P1 must bind the final exact file set before implementation.
